name: DHL Supply Chain - IDS Fulfillment DC - Atlanta GA

fieldNotes.location: Roster had no address/coords. Resolved via web research: IDS Fulfillment's Atlanta-metro DC is at 495 Coweta Industrial Parkway, Newnan GA 30265 ('Scout 85 Logistics' / 'Scout Cold Logistics Center Atlanta-II'), a 215,822 sq ft Class A rear-load building completed 2022, full-building lease to IDS Fulfillment (now DHL Supply Chain). Building is in Coweta Industrial Park, ~3 mi east of I-85 Exit 47.
fieldNotes.buildingIdNote: Audited the large single-tenant white tilt-up rear-load building at ~33.4101,-84.7256 on the south side of Coweta Industrial Parkway. Street View read a building plate as '355' on the NW end, which conflicts with the marketed address '495'; the 355 plate may be a suite/door designation. This is the only building in the park matching the Scout description (single-tenant, ~215k sq ft, rear-load, fully secured/fenced, 2022 construction). Building identity is high-probability but the street-number discrepancy is unresolved — confidence set to medium.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (May 2025) shows the SW dock yard enclosed by chain-link fencing with a sliding gate across the truck driveway at the SW end. Controlled truck entry confirmed; flagged uncertain due to tree cover partially obscuring the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at this building's gate. (A separate guarded gate with a booth exists at the much larger DC further NE in the park, but that is a different building.)
fieldNotes.remoteGs: true — there is a truck gate (sliding gate) but no guard shack, implying kiosk/app/call-box check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Rear-load building: all docks on the SW long face. ~35-45 dock positions counted at z19 with ~32 trailers backed in. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated drop-trailer lot — trailers are all backed at docks; the narrow dock apron has little marked drop parking. 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight dock-yard apron — single drive aisle width along the dock face; queue room is short (1-2 trucks).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Coweta Industrial Park sits in a wooded edge-of-Newnan setting, a small exurban city SW of Atlanta; bordered by tree cover. Rural per rubric (small-town industrial defaults to Rural).
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Low — the fenced dock court is narrow with limited room for drop trailers beyond the dock face itself; estimate ~12.
